column_values.notes: Allowing teens to allocate a % of deposits into a Bitcoin savings bucket. Need to scope custodial wallet compliance requirements first.

items.name: Launch Step Visa debit card v2

column_values.notes: v2 card has new Beast-branded design, tap-to-pay, and higher daily spend limit. Visa onboarding for new BIN range finalized. Card art approved by Jimmy.
Parents need spending category blocks, real-time alerts, and transfer approval flows. This is a top feature request from onboarding survey feedback.
P2P between Step users — basically Venmo for teens. Needs fraud modeling and regulatory review before we start building.
Shipped Aug 1. Users can see their credit score directly in the app via Experian integration. DAU engagement up 18% since launch. 🎉
Step mention drops in Jimmy's next video (est. 200M views). CTA drives to step.com/beast. Landing page is live. Attribution pixel confirmed with eng team.
BTS push running Aug 20–Sept 15. Paid social on TikTok + Instagram. $200K budget. Currently at 47K new signups vs 60K goal. CPL tracking at $4.26.
Seeding Step debit cards to 150 teen/Gen-Z creators (10K–500K followers). Card kits being designed. Shortlisting creators now via Aspire.
A/B testing 6 TikTok creatives — 3 UGC-style, 3 polished. Testing $5K each before scaling winner. Creative briefs sent to production team.
Shipped Aug 25 — new onboarding flow for 18-year-olds aging up to full Step accounts. Completion rate up 22% vs old flow. Rolled out to all new signups.
P95 transaction latency spiked to 3.2s after the Aug 30 deploy. Root cause: N+1 query in payment authorization flow. Fix is in staging, testing looks good.
iOS 18 drops Sept 16. App is compatible — fixed 2 deprecation warnings. Awaiting App Store review submission sign-off from Priya.
Refactoring KYC flow to support new Alloy SDK v3. Also improves step-up verification for users flagged by fraud model. Legal reviewed new consent copy.

items.name: API rate limiting for new partners

column_values.notes: New partner integrations (Feastables loyalty, merch store) need rate limiting on the Step API. Implementing token bucket per partner_id. PR open for review.
Shipped Aug 22 on iOS and Android. App Store rating went from 4.6 to 4.8 within a week. Most requested feature ever on our feedback board.
Spike in KYC failures this week — ~300 tickets since Sept 5. Likely related to Alloy SDK upgrade in progress. Eng team aware and working a hotfix.
Ongoing issue — card fulfillment vendor Idemia had a print delay in late August. ~180 cards stuck. Working with Idemia on expedited re-issue. Notifying affected users.
Parents can't link to teen accounts after parental controls dashboard rollout. Reproducible on iOS 17.5+. Ticket sent to eng — looks like a session token scoping bug.
~90 unresolved chargeback disputes >14 days old — Visa requires resolution in 30 days. Escalated to Head of CX and COO. Need temp staffing support to clear backlog.

items.name: Feastables loyalty points via Step wallet

column_values.notes: When a Step user buys Feastables with their Step card, they earn loyalty points visible in the Step app. API contract between Step and Feastables backend is drafted.
Adding Step as a native checkout option on shopmrbeast.com. Shopify plugin approach — Step Pay SDK. QA in progress on sandbox. Waiting on Shopify partnership approval.

items.name: Beast Games prize payout via Step

column_values.notes: Idea: Beast Games winners (Season 2) receive prize money deposited directly to their Step account. Huge acquisition play for Step. Legal needs to review prize payout regulations first.
Lunchly pack with a Step QR code inside — scan to get $5 in your Step account. Packaging printer confirmed. Step eng building QR redemption flow. Launch tied to BTS season.
BTS limited edition — 'Pencil Case' packaging on Deez Nuts bar. 500K units. Walmart exclusive for first 2 weeks. Packaging approved, production on track.
Feastables expanding from 1,200 to 2,800 Walmart doors in Q4. Planogram submitted and approved. First wave of new doors going live Oct 1.

items.name: Beast Games Season 2 — episode brief finalization

column_values.notes: Jimmy's approved the core game concepts for all 10 episodes. Writers room finalizing challenge rules and pacing. Amazon Prime review call scheduled Sept 18.
Casting 2,000 contestants globally. Applications close Sept 30. Travel and accommodation vendor (IMG Events) confirmed. NDA framework with legal finalized.
Negotiating weekly vs bi-weekly episode drop cadence with Amazon. We want weekly to maintain momentum. Amazon wants 2-week hold to build subscriber retention. Legal in talks.
KSI's current deal expires Oct 1. Renewing for 12 months covering Feastables and Step. KSI team wants an equity component — looping in Jimmy and legal.
Logan Paul wants to co-create a Lunchly flavor. Term sheet sent. His team is asking for a higher rev share than we can do. Counter proposed with exclusivity period instead.
Building a tiered ambassador program — 50 mid-tier creators (100K–2M) for Step and Feastables. Tier 1 gets paid deal + card. Tier 2 gets gifting + commission. Brief going to legal.

updates.item_name: Launch Step Visa debit card v2
updates.body: card art got final approval from jimmy today!! going with the dark gradient + beast logo. sending to idemia for production run this week. on track for oct 1 🔥

replies.body: finally! this card looks so clean. teens are gonna go crazy for it

updates.body: shipped category blocking to staging yesterday — parents can now block gambling, crypto, and adult content. testing tomorrow with 5 internal families. sofia is killing it on this
MrBeast approved the creative brief and CTA copy. video drops sept 14. we're estimating 300-500K new signups in the first 48 hours based on step.com/beast traffic from his last mention

replies.body: eng team is prepped — we've load tested to 1M signups/hour. infra is ready whenever the video drops
landing page is looking 🔥 good work mia

updates.body: found it — it was a missing index on transactions.user_id that was doing full table scans on every auth call. added the index in staging, p95 latency dropped from 3.2s to 210ms. deploying to prod tonight

replies.body: amazing catch, ship it ASAP. i'll be on standby tonight if anything goes sideways

updates.body: shipped to staging, testing tomorrow with QA team. 2 deprecation warnings fixed (UIWebView refs we forgot to clean up). app is fully compatible with ios 18. just need priya's sign-off to submit to app store

confirmed with dev — the alloy sdk v3 migration broke the fallback identity check for users without SSN (minors). hotfix is being cut tonight. in the meantime we're manually approving flagged accounts that pass our internal checks

replies.body: hotfix is ready, going through final QA now. should be in prod by 11pm tonight

updates.body: escalated to COO. getting 2 temp CX agents from our BPO partner starting monday to help clear the backlog. visa compliance team aware — gave us a 45-day window before any penalty risk

updates.item_name: Feastables loyalty points via Step wallet
updates.body: API contract between step and feastables backend is finalized and signed off. dev patel is starting the step-side implementation this sprint. feastables backend team has their end scoped out. target: live nov 1
shopify partnership approval came through! we're officially a shopify partner. QA on sandbox looks clean — 94% of test transactions passing. known issue: apple pay fallback edge case, ryo is fixing

replies.body: apple pay fix is trivial — will have it done today. launch is looking really close

updates.body: packaging printer confirmed — 500K packs with the step QR code inside. QR redemption flow is being built by eng this sprint (itm-3004 api work). launch date locked: oct 1. this collab is gonna be huge for both brands

updates.item_name: Beast Games Season 2 — episode brief finalization
updates.body: jimmy ran through all 10 episode concepts in the writers room today. loved 8 of them, wants to rework episodes 4 and 7. new drafts due by sept 15. amazon review call is still sept 18 — should be fine

call with KSI's management team yesterday. they're really excited about step — they think it aligns well with KSI's personal finance content. equity ask is ~0.5% — looping jimmy and our finance lead to assess

replies.body: waiting on legal to sign off on the equity structure before we counter. should have a response by EOW

updates.body: logan's team came back — they're open to the exclusivity period trade instead of higher rev share. 6-month exclusivity for Lunchly in the meal kit space feels workable. sending revised term sheet monday

week 3 update: 47K signups, pacing toward 55K by end of campaign (sept 15). CPL is $4.26 — slightly above $3.80 target but conversion-to-active is 71% which is really strong. keeping current spend levels
alloy SDK v3 integration is 40% done. legal just approved the new consent copy — big unlock since that was blocking the compliance review. targeting staging deploy by sept 12 and prod sept 19

docs.name: Step Product Vision 2026
docs.content_summary: North star document for Step's product strategy in 2026. Covers the core thesis (financial literacy for Gen-Z), key product pillars (smart debit, credit building, savings, family controls), acquisition strategy via Beast ecosystem, and 2026 OKRs. Living doc — updated quarterly by product leadership.

docs.name: Beast Industries x Step Integration Roadmap
docs.content_summary: Master roadmap for all integration touchpoints between Step and the Beast Industries portfolio. Covers Feastables loyalty integration, MrBeast merch checkout, Beast Games prize payouts, and Lunchly QR promotions. Includes technical architecture diagrams, go-live timelines, and cross-functional owners for each integration.

docs.name: Step Growth Playbook — Back to School 2026
docs.content_summary: Full campaign playbook for Step's Back-to-School 2026 growth push. Covers campaign strategy, channel breakdown (TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, influencer seeding), budget allocation, creative brief, KPIs (signup volume, CPL, 30-day activation rate), and weekly performance check-in cadence.

docs.name: Creator Partnership SOP
docs.content_summary: Standard operating procedures for managing creator and influencer partnerships at Beast Industries. Covers deal intake process, tier definitions (mega, macro, mid-tier, nano), term sheet templates, compliance and FTC disclosure requirements, gifting logistics, performance tracking, and renewal playbooks.
